caption_L1: This is a line graph titled Mozambique : Age structure from 2009 to 2019. The y-axis shows 65 years and older along linear scale of range 0.000 to 0.035 while the x-axis measures Year on linear scale of range 2010 to 2018.
caption_L2L3: on average, over a 10 year period the number of above 65 years has declined 0.003. 0.0015 each 5 years respectively. Each year there has been either a decline or levelling in the overall number of less than 65s. There has been no increase in the number of over 65 years old. From these trends we can deduce that the overall population of over 65s is reducing and the number of under 65s is increasing at the rate 0.003 per 10 years or 0.0003 per year.
